runtimeHandoff.convention: Runtime resets exact native rest local quaternion, then right-multiplies axis-angle(axisLocal,maxRadians). Bone positions remain exact rest. Socket quaternion is world socket orientation, not wrist orientation.

fullSurface.scope: Every selected glove triangle whose positive skin influences belong entirely to the same native wrist/palm/digit subtree; forearm cuff excluded and must be checked in full runtime arm pose

method: Damped differential IK of fixed source pulp material against explicit finite targets; no coordinate descent or parameter grid

index.method: Proximal-to-distal positive hinge closure, with descendants included at PIP/DIP to first actual descendant-skin contact;5degree swept brackets then30bisections, no multi-parameter fit

middle.method: Proximal-to-distal positive hinge closure, with descendants included at PIP/DIP to first actual descendant-skin contact;5degree swept brackets then30bisections, no multi-parameter fit

ring.method: Proximal-to-distal positive hinge closure, with descendants included at PIP/DIP to first actual descendant-skin contact;5degree swept brackets then30bisections, no multi-parameter fit

pinky.method: Proximal-to-distal positive hinge closure, with descendants included at PIP/DIP to first actual descendant-skin contact;5degree swept brackets then30bisections, no multi-parameter fit

source.method: Actual native CMC-to-terminal-thumb shaft and index-MCP direction define the opposition plane; its transverse hinge is projected off each actual thumb shaft and expressed in its native rest local frame. No rest transform, source skin, mesh or digital translation is changed.
source.anatomicalBasis: PMC3653006 Discussion describes thumb pronation approximately90degrees relative to palm; global palm-normal flex alone is not an independent thumb opposition-plane definition
source.limits: Constructed anatomical control hypothesis; requires actual source pulp normal, contact, whole-surface and moving-parent review.
